scenario: Fictional training case. A member requests routine MRI authorization. Membership is active and the imaging provider is in network. A signed specialist referral is attached. The member says they completed six weeks of conservative treatment, but the required treatment summary is missing. No exception is requested. What should the reviewer do next?

Fictional training case. A member requests four outpatient therapy visits. Membership is active, the provider is in network, and two visits have already been used this benefit year. A treatment plan requesting four visits is attached, but the signed clinician referral is missing. No exception is requested. What should the reviewer do next?

Fictional training case. A member requests a two-hundred-dollar reimbursement thirty days after a covered service. Membership was active on the service date and the provider is in network. The completed claim form and itemized invoice are attached, but proof of payment is missing. The member says they paid in full. There are no conflicting records or exception requests. What should the reviewer do next?
